title: What you leave to follow
framework: Genesis 12 (sabbath) — Sabbath: rest in unseen promise

panels.heading: TODAY’S PASSAGE
panels.content:
**Genesis 12 (sabbath)**

This devotional is being drafted. The full reading + reflection ships in a future writing pass.

In the meantime, open your Bible to Genesis 12 (sabbath) and read it slowly. Sit with one phrase that catches you. Bring it back to mind tomorrow.

panels.heading: WHY THIS PASSAGE
panels.content:
Today’s pivot: Sabbath: rest in unseen promise. The whole canon points forward — and this reading carries its own thread of that long pointing.

Christ-link: Christ’s invitation (Matt 4:19).

panels.heading: A PRAYER
panels.content: Father, when I read this passage, let me see You truly. Slow my hurry. Soften my certainty. Show me what I have missed. Through Christ, who is the substance of every shadow. Amen.
